description: A JPEG of a Workspace as the user's window shows it now (the part in view). With width (CSS pixels), a preview of the whole Workspace at that window width instead: the placement adapted to that width, each Tile's last frame rescaled, so it's approximate. A Workspace not on the user's screen is previewed at the user's window width. Tiles you can't see (Private sites') are plain boxes labelled "Private site".
name: workspace_image
